integrity.claim_scope: Exact deterministic return towers, finite-horizon clock distributions and rational least periods; not a claim of new inducing or Sturmian theory.
integrity.computational_evidence: Standalone standard-library exact-rational checker passed 54 parameter cases, 3456 base samples, 700 least-period trajectories, and 180 two-atom-moment tests.
integrity.mathematical_evidence: Algebraic first-return itinerary and modular coprimality, floor identity for circle rotations, two-atom pushforward measure, and full-period transfer through invertible towers.
integrity.unproved_limits: No generalization to degenerate caps, arbitrary planar initial states or other piecewise isometries is asserted.

scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to the specified four-interval cap exchange with strictly positive segment lengths and the regular part of the associated polygonal embedding; no planar basin assertion is made.
The roof and clock formulas hold in the half-open algebraic model; geometric boundary assignments may require exclusion of breakpoint orbits.
Publication-priority risk remains for other literature stating an equivalent induced rotation tower with quantified original-time statistics.
title: Two-height return towers and bounded physical-time clocks on translated-cone caps
